productName: Here For You Refundable Accident Plus

trends.whatProductOffers: Reimburses accident-related medical expenses incurred within 52 weeks, up to HK$/MOP1,200 to 5,800 per accident depending on plan, covering hospitalisation, surgery, X-ray and physiotherapy.

keyFigures.label: Reimbursement window
keyFigures.condition: Expenses must be incurred within this period

keyFigures.label: Bone-setting benefit
keyFigures.condition: Max 1 visit per day and 6 visits per policy year

exclusionsOrConditions: Chinese bone-setting and chiropractor treatment are not covered under the medical expenses benefit.
Bone-setting is paid only under its separate benefit.
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Since {client_detail}, accident bills up to the plan limit are reimbursed for a year after the injury.
verificationPrompts: Ask about the client's sports and commute
Confirm the expected medical cost level
Check whether bone-setting is a priority
sourceEvidence: "reimburse the medical expenses incurred within 52 weeks after the accident, up to the maximum limit for the plan selected"

trends.whatProductOffers: Pays a daily hospital income benefit for accident-related hospitalisation up to 90 days per accident, a lump-sum in-patient surgical cash benefit, and an accidental TPD lump sum of up to HK$/MOP1,000,000.

keyFigures.label: Hospital income
keyFigures.condition: Plans 1 to 4; max 90 days per accident

keyFigures.label: In-patient surgical cash
keyFigures.condition: Surgery within 180 days of the accident

keyFigures.label: Accidental TPD
keyFigures.condition: TPD on or before age 65; policy terminates after payment

exclusionsOrConditions: TPD applies only on or before age 65 or for the specified losses/ADL inability for at least 6 months.
Surgical cash requires surgery within 180 days.
Hospital income is capped at 90 days per accident.
The policy terminates once the TPD benefit is paid.
clientSignalPhrases: wants a lump sum if disabled
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, the daily and surgical cash benefits replace income while an accident keeps them out of work.
verificationPrompts: Ask whether the client has paid sick leave
Check the client's age against the TPD age limit
sourceEvidence: "pay a daily income benefit for each day of hospitalisation and up to a maximum of 90 days per accident"
"Accidental Hospital Income Benefit (per day, up to a maximum of 90 days per accident) 250 400 450 700"

trends.whatProductOffers: A 16-year accident plan paid over 8 years that refunds 100% of total premiums paid, without interest, at the end of the policy term whether or not claims were made.

keyFigures.label: Policy term
keyFigures.condition: Cover ceases at the end of the term

keyFigures.label: Premium payment term
keyFigures.condition: Premiums fixed throughout the payment period

keyFigures.label: Maturity refund
keyFigures.condition: Without interest; whether or not claims were made

keyFigures.label: Surrender value
keyFigures.value: 0% before year 6; 50% years 6-10; 80% years 11-15; 100% at year 16

exclusionsOrConditions: Early surrender returns 0% before the 6th policy anniversary.
Cover ends when the refund is paid.
The premium is not a savings return.
clientSignalPhrases: wants money back if no claim
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Given {client_detail}, the plan returns every premium paid at year 16 even if claims were made along the way.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the client can lock funds for 16 years
Check understanding that the refund pays no interest
Ask whether early surrender is likely
sourceEvidence: "we will refund 100% of your total premiums paid at the end of the policy term"
"You will pay just 8 years of premium for 16 years of broad accident protection."

trends.whatProductOffers: Offers four plan levels and lets the main insured cover a spouse aged 18-56 or a child from 15 days to 17, with a 15% premium discount for family members on the same or lower plan.

keyFigures.label: Family discount
keyFigures.condition: Same or lower plan level; for the whole premium payment term

exclusionsOrConditions: The discount requires purchase at the same time and at the same or a lower plan level.
Child rates apply from 15 days to age 17.
clientSignalPhrases: wants to cover the whole family
negativeSignalPhrases: needs cover past age 17 for the child
trends.talkingPointTemplate: Since {client_detail}, adding the spouse and children at the same time cuts their premiums by 15%.
verificationPrompts: Confirm ages of spouse and children
Check whether plans will be at the same level
sourceEvidence: "if you purchase plans for one or more members of your immediate family at the same time as your own plan, they will enjoy a 15% discount"

trends.whatProductOffers: Provides 24/7 worldwide emergency assistance, including emergency medical evacuation and repatriation and hospitalisation assistance, up to HK$/MOP500,000 per life across all AIA policies.

keyFigures.label: Assistance limit
keyFigures.condition: Total across all policies issued by AIA/AIA Company Limited

exclusionsOrConditions: The limit is shared across all AIA policies for the same insured.
Applies when travelling outside Hong Kong or Macau.
These are assistance services, not a cash benefit for every expense.
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, the 24/7 assistance line and evacuation cover apply wherever the accident happens.
verificationPrompts: Ask about travel frequency and destinations
Confirm the client has no overlapping assistance cover
Check awareness of the shared limit
sourceEvidence: "emergency medical evacuation and repatriation, and hospitalisation assistance, including a China Assist Card"
"up to a maximum total value of HK$ / MOP500,000 in emergency assistance services per life under all policies"
trends.notesForReviewer: The benefit is described as assistance services; cash reimbursement scope is not detailed in the extract.

productLevelSummary.bestForOneLiner: A 16-year refundable accident plan with four cover levels, accident medical reimbursement, daily hospital income and 100% premium refund at maturity.
notSuitedWhen: The client needs illness or hospital medical cover
The client cannot commit premiums for 8 years
The client wants investment growth rather than a premium refund
gapsInSourceMaterial: Full premium table by age and plan
